findings.summary: The deliberate choice that an empty allowlist is fingerprint-identity-neutral is consistent with ADR-017 and the 12.1 scope boundary.
findings.detail: ADR-017 clause 6 requires the resolved allowlists to be included in `RendererConfigurationFingerprint` and pairs that with a coordinated schema (1->2) and `RenderVersion` (2->3) advance plus golden regeneration. The phase plan assigns that coordinated advance to task 12.4 and explicitly forbids 12.1 from advancing versions or regenerating goldens. `RendererConfigurationFingerprint.AppendAllowedValues` returns early for an empty list, so the default configuration fingerprint is byte-identical to its pre-task value (provable by inspection: the only computation change is the early-returning `AppendAllowedValues` call). Since an empty list means 'no restriction' (ADR-017 clause 1) it is semantically identical to the pre-allowlist default, so treating it as identity-neutral is correct and is the only choice consistent with the 12.1 boundary. Non-empty allowlists are included, satisfying the 12.1 acceptance criterion. This does not preclude task 12.4 from representing the empty default explicitly alongside its version advance.
evidence: PLANS.md 12.4 work item (schema 1->2, RenderVersion 2->3, golden regeneration)
PLANS.md 12.1 acceptance: fingerprint changes when the allowlist changes

acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_is_bounded: MET. `BadgeSelectorConfiguration.AllowedValues` is validated in `RendererConfiguration.Validate` against `BadgeDefinition.MaximumAllowedValues` (32) and `MaximumAllowedValueLength` (64), and the resolved `BadgeDefinition` enforces the same bounds. Tests: ValidatorRejectsTooManyAllowedValues, ValidatorRejectsTooLongAllowedValue, DefinitionRejectsUnusableAllowedValues.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_validated_at_configuration_loa: MET. `RendererConfiguration.Validate` calls `ValidateAllowedValues` per selector; `PluginConfigurationValidator.Validate` rejects invalid configs and `ConfigurationSnapshotService.TryReplace` retains the last valid snapshot (test: SnapshotServiceRetainsLastValidRendererConfigurationOnInvalidAllowlist). Rules verified in source: trim, blank rejected, control chars rejected, case-insensitive duplicates rejected.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlist_secret_free: MET. Error messages contain only the selector enum name and numeric constants, never the configured value (test: AllowedValuesValidationMessagesAreSecretFree; source inspection of all six message strings).
acceptance_criteria_assessment.fingerprint_changes_when_allowlist_chang: MET. Non-empty resolved allowlists are appended to the fingerprint with case/order normalization (test: RendererFingerprintIsSensitiveToAllowedValuesAndNormalizesCaseAndOrder asserts sensitivity to values and identity for case-only/order-only changes). Empty allowlist is deliberately identity-neutral (see 12.1-F3).
acceptance_criteria_assessment.scope_no_filtering_behavior: MET. `AllowedValues` is referenced only in BadgeSelectorConfiguration, RendererConfiguration.Validate, RendererConfigurationFingerprint, RendererConfigurationResolver, config.html, and BadgeDefinition; BadgeSelectorResolver/BadgeDefinitionResolver/BadgeLayoutEngine contain no allowlist logic.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.scope_no_size_position: MET. No BadgePosition/BadgeSize or layout-engine change is present in the diff.
